personal.about: Unity Developer with professional experience building multiplayer games, VR/XR applications, AR experiences, robotics simulations, educational technology platforms, interactive training systems, and mobile applications. Strong experience in C#, Unity, multiplayer and client-server architecture, VR/XR, AR, UI/UX, backend integration, REST APIs, visual programming, custom editors, Python code generation, AI/computer vision, and third-party SDK integration. Experienced in developing complete interactive systems from software architecture and UI/UX design to gameplay, networking, authentication, platform services, and performance optimization.

description: Teach programming from scratch, starting with computational thinking and beginner-friendly visual programming.

Guide students through building games from scratch, including Pong, multiplayer Pong, Super Mario-style games, and car/racing games.
Use game development to teach programming, problem-solving, algorithms, and logical thinking.
Progress students from visual programming into text-based programming, including Python and JavaScript.
Introduce modern development technologies through practical projects, including React and Flutter.
Teach C# and Unity for students progressing toward professional game development.
Teach robotics and programming concepts through hands-on projects and interactive simulations.
Adapt lessons for students with different programming experience levels.
